top_signals.title: Healey has left £49bn blackhole in Britain’s finances, claims Badenoch
top_signals.summary: John Healey has left the UK with a £49bn black hole that will require substantial tax increases, Kemi Badenoch has claimed. The Conservative party leader said Labour would have to raise taxes by £,1,700 per household annually by the 2030/31 financial year to pay for unfunded spending promises.
